items.headline: U.S. Futures Rise Amid Diplomacy Hopes and Upcoming Economic Data
items.summary: U.S. stock futures advanced today, signaling a positive start to the trading week, as markets react to renewed hopes of diplomacy with Iran. Investors are also closely watching a heavy slate of economic updates, including today's ISM Manufacturing PMI, and key quarterly earnings reports throughout the week. The S&P 500 is currently trading higher by 0.51%, reflecting modest broader market gains.

items.headline: Futurewave Acquisition Surges
items.summary: Futurewave Acquisition (FWAC) experienced a massive surge, gaining over 460% today, continuing a significant upward trend observed over the past month.

items.headline: Amazon Leads S&P 500 Gainers

items.headline: ISM Manufacturing PMI and Global S&P Manufacturing PMI Released Today
items.summary: Investors are monitoring the release of the U.S. ISM Manufacturing PMI and the final Global S&P Manufacturing PMI for July today, which are key indicators for the health of the manufacturing sector. These reports provide insight into business conditions and inflation pressures.

items.headline: Palantir and ON Semiconductor Report Earnings
items.summary: Major earnings reports from Palantir ($PLTR) and ON Semiconductor ($ON) are scheduled for today. These results could influence sentiment in the software and semiconductor sectors, respectively, as earnings season continues.

items.headline: Markets Eye September Fed Rate Hike Prospects
items.summary: Following last week's decision by the Federal Reserve to hold interest rates steady, markets are now pricing in a 64.5% likelihood of a rate hike at the September FOMC meeting. The Fed's cautious stance, despite some dissenting votes for a hike, keeps future economic data releases like this week's nonfarm payrolls firmly in focus.

items.headline: Stock Market Enters Historically Weak Season
items.summary: The stock market has entered August, traditionally a weaker period for the S&P 500, with both August and September historically averaging negative returns. This seasonality comes as the index has already seen robust gains year-to-date.

items.headline: Broad Bullish Structure in Key Sectors
items.summary: Analysis indicates strong bullish setups across several sectors, including semiconductors, AI infrastructure, consumer discretionary, mega-cap AI, fintech, cloud, crypto beta, materials, healthcare, and energy. While no clear sector rotation regime is confirmed, broad positive sentiment is evident if the broader market stabilizes.
